programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Double Date Disaster. It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Table Tennis Trick. Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Walking Into Trouble. Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Baby. When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: What’s That Smell. One cat’s delicacy is another mouse’s poison. Tom and Jerry get caught in a thorny issue over the aroma of durian. Will the King of Fruits help reconcile their differences?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Cuckoo Clock. Ginger places her granny's old cuckoo clock in the hall, and it still works! However, the newly arrived clock causes issues when Tom wants to catch the tiny wooden bird inside and Tuffy wants to befriend it.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Plant Food. At midnight, a gothic lady cat appears with her favorite sinister plant creatures including her personal favorite: Fang, a big man-eating plant. As long as it's sealed in the hothouse, nothing can go wrong. But Tom, Jerry and Tuffy soon have their hands full with the escaped plant.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Bird Flue. Cates appears and assigns Tom the job of sweeping the estate's chimneys, warning him not to upset the Duchess's new exotic pet bird. Unfortunately, both the pet bird and a stork at the top of the chimney think Jerry is a worm. Soon chaos breaks out, hurting Tom's cleaning efforts.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: A Star Forlorn. When Tom finds out he won a contest to be in a cat food commercial, his behavior turns smug. This irritates Jerry, who goes to great lengths to ruin the commercial shoot at the house as Tom struggles in his role.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Eggs on a Train. Peter, a pretentious cheapskate poodle, demands that Tom and Jerry help protect his precious sapphire egg on a train journey but won't pay their fare. The cat and mouse become stowaways and go to a lot of trouble to do their job, but the outcome is unexpected.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Raptor Raiders. The Dino Ranchers race to track down a high-pitched squeak. What they find is a baby Ankylosaurus, squeaking in panic as a pack of Raptors circles in for the attack! Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Noodles Finds Some Friends. The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: In the pink. Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Dinner for two. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Sample Sale. Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Grounded. Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Grand Scam. Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Me, Myself and A.I. When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Gremlin on a Plane. The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this 'bear's privilege,' except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Party Time! Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The Beast from the Bayou. When Tom goes through reverse evolution and is transformed into a swamp monster, he uses it to his advantage, scaring creatures that frightened him earlier. Soon he sees Van Mouseling in the woods and can't resist chasing him all over.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Lightning Bug Blues. Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Wrap Star. Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Perfume Party. Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Charm School Dropouts. When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Driven Crazy. Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Walking Into Trouble. Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The New Dress. In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Wicket's Driving Lesson. Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Prize Photo. Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Snack. Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Neighbourly Bean. As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Food Fight. Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: I Scooby Dooby Do. The gang is honored to take part in the wedding of two close friends. But can Best Man, Shaggy, and Maid of Honor, Daphne, save their friend's perfect day before it's ruined by a tragic Ghost Bride bent on destroying everyone else's Happily Ever After?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: El Bandito. He gang head out to a Day of the Dead festival. There, they learn the spirit of the old, legendary criminal, El Bandito, has returned to terrorize the locals. Fred becomes obsessed with solving the mystery and becoming a part of the great legend, himself.

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Pup Mix. Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Welcome to the Island. The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Present. Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Lord Bean. Mr Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean. Mr Bean sets off to track down his ancestral home (a castle) in Scotland where he is welcomed with open arms. But owning a castle is not cheap. Can Mr Bean escape before he runs out of money and has there been a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Car Wars. Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Wedding Day. Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Supertrolley. Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day. Subscribing to the theory that bigger is better, he constructs his own shopping trolley incorporating a petrol mower, pram wheels and an extra pair of hydraulic hands.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Disorderly Dominoes. Baby Raccoon has set about clearing the forest of everything in sight: bark, pine cones, twigs.... But the Baby Lemmings are using all these elements to make increasingly incredible domino courses! When Baby Raccoon discovers this, he just feels they've made a mess of the forest again, and decides to pick it up despite the Baby Lemmings' annoyance.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: For the Baby Lemmings, the whole world is a playground, and there’s nothing better than sharing this joyful philosophy of life with their little animal neighbours in the Canadian forest. When you see the world through Lemming eyes, you can overcome any challenge – and have a whole lot of fun along the way!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Adverse Winds. It's a windy day in the Canadian forest, and Baby Lynx is having fun catching flying leaves like a little kitten. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Renn Scare. The gang heads to the Velma's beloved authentic Renaissance Faire, where they must find a way to infiltrate the royal feast in order to stop an evil court jester from ending the king's reign, permanently, and closing the faire!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: How to Train Your Coward. Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Dinner for two. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Valentine's Bean. Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: A Game of Bones. After Tyke digs up, Hammy, Spike's lucky bone, Spike reburies it right away because it's bad luck to remove it. Soon afterward, Tom gets a set of toy dog bones that do tricks, and he teases Spike and Tyke with them. When the whirly-bone buries itself and unearths Hammy for a second time, Spike recruits the other animals to help prevent the bad luck he expects.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Suitable for Framing. A ghost paints a flattering portrait of Tom, but Tom is stingy with his payment and the ghost casts a spell on the portrait. Strange things start happening as the portrait absorbs injuries and calories that should be affecting Tom. However, soon Jerry and Tuffy figure out what's going on and use it to their advantage.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Springtime for Spike. When Rick and Ginger are asked to dog-sit for a friend's French poodle, Sabrina, Tom is initially on his guard, but soon he's practically eating out of her hand. Next, Spike falls for Sabrina and does everything he can to impress her with how kind he is to Tom. How long will everyone's behavior be affected by Sabrina's presence?

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders II
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders brings the wackiness, humor and slapstick we've grown to love to a new preschool audience. At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage a crew of builders that, quite frankly, should not be anywhere near a construction site. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Taxi Bean. Mr Bean takes a taxi to his local toyshop but a dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Mr Bean for a ride. After a mix up Mr Bean finds himself driving the taxi and starts to have fun couriering people to their destinations even giving an American tourist an extensive tour of London. But will the taxi driver find out what’s been going on and how much will Bean’s final fare be?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Muscle Bean. Mr Bean needs to impress Irma who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman. Bean tries to improve his physique at the gym but has little success. Instead he opts for an inflatable muscle suit. Irma is indeed impressed and Bean’s plan seems to be working – until the suit gets punctured and Bean makes the mistake of re-inflating it with helium. As Bean floats off into the sky will Irma’s admiration be punctured?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Feeding Time. Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Pretend Patient. Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: Journey into the heart of Singapore with Tom and Jerry as they weave through the labyrinth of towering estates and skyscrapers and bask in the vibrant green of the urban jungle.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Hiding At Home. Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Bath Bother. Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Opera For One. Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean Hatches A Plan. Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Age Remote. The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: The Eyes Of A Villain. During training at the Hero Base, the SuperThings mistake Kid Fury for a villain because of his yellow eyes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Game Changer. As Jerry and Tuffy play marbles, Tom throws a soccer ball in their direction and upsets the game. This sparks a chase between Tom and Jerry, and Jerry takes cover in a room that looks like a giant chessboard. As more chess pieces show up, Tom and Jerry attempt their best to outplay them.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back. The all-new series takes another look at the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Rosemary's Gravy. Because of an injured foot, Rick stays home with Ginger's mother, Rosemary, taking care of him. Rosemary brings her infamous fat-free-dairy-free whole wheat gravy, and she quickly puts Rick, Spike and Tom on nutritious diets. Antics and fights break out as Rick and the pets crave real food.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Hula Whoops. Tom and Jerry take a case for Toodles' cousin in Hawaii, hoping to sneak in some rest and relaxation, but it's no vacation. The cousin's missing pineapple plant is only the starting place of the investigation as Tom and Jerry track down the culprit in this tropical environment.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Kiss and Makeup. Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Welcome to the Island. The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Present. Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: The Ball. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Toothache. Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry Gokko celebrates the calmness and simplicity of everyday life and embraces play between our iconic characters and showcases their friendly rivalries and friendships in this cute new stylization.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Oak in progress. Baby Beaver tries to stockpile wood for construction by cutting down a few trees with his teeth. But it's a long and tedious process. When he realizes that Baby Lemmings are talented rodents, he tries to convince them to help him with his mission. But he doesn't anticipate the creative spirit of the Baby Lemmings, who can't be satisfied with just cutting logs without having fun!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: High-wire act. The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Foolhardy Plushie. Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: Third Wheel. Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Bean Phone. Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Hotel Bean. A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Train Trouble. Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Blown Away. Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Autograph Hunter. When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: In the wild. Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: World of Witchcraft. The gang goes to Salem, Massachusetts for a historical festival, only to discover history repeating itself as a demon has been set loose on the town, summoned by a witch as revenge for the infamous 17th Century Salem Witch Trials.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Professor Huh? Part 1. Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean's Baby. When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Movie Mayhem. Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Ghost Spotters. When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Necklace Thief. Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Big Shrink. When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Nurse! Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Batwheels II

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Into the Mouth of Madcap. Daphne agrees to watch her friend's kid, Wayne, and convinces Fred to take a night off from mysteries to go to the boardwalk amusement park. Unbeknownst to her, though, the park is being haunted by a fiendish clown, Madcap.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: The Norse Case Scenario. The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away – or worse.

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Lamput is a gooey orange nutcase that has escaped from the asylum! Two Docs are out to get him, but the problem is they can never catch him becasue Lamput is a master of disguise!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Best Brother. Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. But before the predators can strike, Uncle Jack and Pa swoop in, tackling the dinos with daring moves and perfect timing! As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: The Perfect Last Day. It’s Ma and Pa’s last day on Dino Island, and the Ranchers are determined to make it perfect! So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Bean Phone. Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Hotel Bean. A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Jurassic Bean. Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Magpie. When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles. When the police arrive to investigate the theft of his landlady’s jewellery, it’s not just Mr. Bean that needs to take flight.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Team Challenge. Baby Lynx is desperately looking for a worthy opponent to race against. When she sees the Baby Lemmings chasing an apple rolling down a slope, she wants to race against them. But in reality, they are really bad at it! Baby Lynx decides to train the Baby Lemmings in the hope of having real opponents.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Growing Impatient. The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Landscape layout. The Baby Lemmings discover that they can make blue paint by crushing berries and start covering the forest with funny little drawings of their own invention. When the Baby Lynx sees this, she gets in on the act and decides to cover the forest with drawings in her own colour, red. A natural graffiti battle ensues between her and the baby lemmings.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Worst in Show. After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! II
programme.desc: Mysteries on the Disorient Express. Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: The Ball. The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: All You Can Eat. Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Knighty Knight Knight. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy have a run-in with a moving suit of armor. The knight scares Tom away, but Jerry makes a brave stand because he thinks the knight is Tom in disguise. Jerry eventually trips the suit of armor and finds out it's inhabited by three kittens. Relieved at first, the pets soon realize that battling one haunted knight is nothing compared to battling three real-life kittens.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Calorie Count. Jerry's high-born cousin Count DaCalories—a haughty city mouse—visits the estate. At first, he acts sleek and refined, but soon he can't resist pigging out and going on multiple kitchen raids. As his paunch grows, it becomes more and more difficult for him to outrun Tom and stay out of sight of the Duchess's visitor.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Phan-Tom of the Oompah. In Catsylvania, the peasant mice oompah band plays onstage at the auditorium. As the bandleader's lovely daughter, Gretta, hits a high note in her rousing song, Tom—in a mask and hood—swings in on a rope and abducts her. Van Mouseling and the peasant band chase him through the rafters and backstage, but Tom escapes with his captive to a subterranean lair. Will the mice manage to free Gretta?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Food Fight. Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: A New Friend. Mr Bean is initially charmed when a seemingly cute seagull turns up on his windowsill. Bean feeds the gull and invites the bird inside. But it’s not long before the seagull in the flat turns out to be a cuckoo in the nest taking over Bean’s home – eating all his food controlling the TV and sleeping in his bed. Bean starts to regret taking on a new best friend in place of good old reliable Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: The Lift. Mr Bean sees a new toy car in the window of the local department store Havlotts and decides he must have it. But on the way to the toy department Mr Bean gets stuck in the lift. He tries his best to entertain his fellow passengers but they aren’t very appreciative. How can Mr Bean resolve the situation and get the toy he so desperately wants?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Window Of Opportunity. Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Irma’s Surprise. When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Remote Control Chaos. Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Feeding Time. Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Pretend Patient. Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Window Of Opportunity. Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Bubble Bath Time. Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Rival Doc. Lamput has escaped yet again, and yet again, Specs and Skinny are in serious trouble with the Boss. He’s so fed up with their constant failure that he hires an out-of-towner: a super cool, hi-tech Doc who has all the moves and the attitude to match.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (31)
programme.desc: Francois plant im Amphitheater der Abenteuerbucht das Stück "Ich, Francois" aufzuführen. Er hat es selbst geschrieben. Es handelt von seinen vielen Abenteuern, die er erlebt hat. Die erste Szene soll in einer Schlucht spielen, in der Francois einst Berglöwen geholfen hat, sich an einer Stelle zu kratzen, an die sie selbst nicht gekommen sind. Chase und Marshall schlüpfen in die Rollen der Löwen, Rocky und Ryder sind für das Bühnenbild zuständig. Beim Proben fällt Francois ein, dass er den Rückenkratzer im Tourneebus vergessen hat, den er neben der Bühne geparkt hat. Er will die Requisite aus dem Bus holen. In einer Kiste sind alle möglichen Sachen verstaut, in denen Francois herumwühlt. Dabei landet ein Akkordeon auf dem Gaspedal des Busses. Dieser rollt nun quer durch die Stadt. Schließlich landet er in einer Schlucht. Von der wilden Fahrt hat Francois nichts mitbekommen, Als er nach draußen tritt, hält er die Schlucht für Rockys Bühnenbild. Kurz darauf tauchen Berglöwen auf. Francois glaubt zunächst, dass Chase und Marshall neue Löwenkostüme tragen. Inzwischen haben auch Ryder und die Fellfreunde bemerkt, dass der Bus und Francois weg sind. Als sie ihn anrufen, sehen sie die Schlucht und die Berglöwen auf dem Handydisplay. Die Paw Patrol darf keine Zeit verlieren, um ihren Freund vor den Löwen zu retten und den Bus aus der Schlucht zu holen. Kein leichtes Unterfangen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (33)
programme.desc: Die Bessi-Patrol. Serie Kanada (2019). Bei der Abenteuerbucht-Tombola werden die Gewinne von Möwen gestohlen, die sie in einem Nest auf der Brücke verstecken. Die Paw Patrol wird gerufen, um die Preise zurückzuholen und Henrietta zu retten, die versucht hat, ihr Kissen zurückzubekommen. Bürgermeister Besserwisser möchte unbedingt an der Rettungsaktion teilnehmen. Darsteller: Julian Henneberg, Flemming Stein, Katharin von Keller, Arlette Stanschuss, Ivo Möller, Nils Rieke, Julia Fölster, Kai-Hendrik Möller, Tina Eschmann, Jens Wendland, Sven Dahlem, Uli Pleßmann, Burkhard Schmeer, Jonas Kirsch, Merete Brettschneider, Daniela Reidies, Laura Pfister, Elisa Pioch, Tom Wiedemann, Liza Ohm, Tim Niebuhr, Maria Wardzinska, Elise Eikermann, Joachim Kretzer, Tetje Mierendorf, Martin May, Elena Wilms, Jesse Grimm, Florian Leroy, Selina Böttcher, Ben Küch, Carla Becker, Malin Steffen. Regie Paul Brown

programme.title: Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (13)
programme.desc: Der letzte Tag im Jahr. Wann ist endlich Mitternacht? Pumuckl kann es kaum erwarten. Denn dann darf er endlich die Wunderkerze aus dem Geschenkkorb eines Kunden anzünden. Die Zeit vergeht dem Kobold viel zu langsam. Doch für Eder ist der gemütliche Abend mit selbstgekochtem Gulasch genau richtig. Er kann dem Silvestertrubel nicht besonders viel abgewinnen. Doch da kommt Michi, und will Eder zum Raclette einladen. Eder findet schnell eine Ausrede. Er sei doch schon bei Klara eingeladen. Doch als diese später ihn zum Essen einladen möchte, behauptet Eder, er sei bei Michi eingeladen. Die Lüge fliegt auf. Und so beschließen die Freunde ihren wunderlichen Freund gemeinsam zum Essen einzuladen. Und seinen Kobold, den soll er ruhig mitbringen. Beim Abendessen in Michis Werkstatt wird aber Flori schnell klar, dass sich die Freunde Sorgen machen, er würde vereinsamen. Den Kobold würde er sich deshalb einbilden. Flori ist gekränkt. Gemeinsam mit Pumuckl heckt er einen Plan aus. Und als dann unerklärliche Dinge in der Radl-Werkstatt passieren, sind sich die Freunde gar nicht mehr so sicher, ob es den Kobold vielleicht nicht doch gibt. Schließlich ist es Mitternacht. Zufrieden spazieren Eder und Pumuckl durch die Straßen Münchens. Im Innenhof der Schreinerei feiern die Nachbarn aus dem Vorderhaus. Vom Dachfenster aus bewundern Eder und Pumuckl das Feuerwerk über der Stadt. Gemeinsam zünden sie nun die Wunderkerze an. Und wünschen sich ein frohes neues Jahr, für das Pumuckl auch schon koboldhafte Vorsätze hat. Und das wird bestimmt lustig werden. Denn er ist schließlich der Pumuckl.

programme.desc: Der Kern erwacht. Serie Japan (2024). Mit achtzehn Pokémon verschiedener Tera-Typen beginnt Pagogo, den Laquim-Kern zu vernichten, doch dann werden Spinel und der Kern eins und verwandeln sich in ein Ungetüm, das Attacken abwehrt und unsere Helden angreift.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show III (17)
programme.desc: Ideen-Notstand. Serie USA (2024). Patrick und Squidina folgen einem geflohenen Ideenbackstein nach Zufallsland. Darsteller: Fritz Rott, Anni C. Salander, Gregor Höppner, Axel Lutter, Anna Dramski, Freimut Götsch, Joachim Kaps, Katja Schmitz, Jonathan Aikins, Sebastian C. Jacob, Fritz Rott, Gerald Schaale, Lucas Wecker, Santiago Ziesmer, Cathlen Gawlich. Regie Sean Dampsey

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show III (18)
programme.desc: Kein hoffnungsloser Fall. Serie USA (2024). Patricks Familie unterrichtet ihn zu Hause, nachdem sie herausfinden, dass er sein Benimmregeln-Training nie abgeschlossen hat. Darsteller: Fritz Rott, Anni C. Salander, Gregor Höppner, Axel Lutter, Anna Dramski, Freimut Götsch, Joachim Kaps, Katja Schmitz, Jonathan Aikins, Sebastian C. Jacob, Fritz Rott, Gerald Schaale, Lucas Wecker, Santiago Ziesmer, Cathlen Gawlich. Regie Sean Dampsey

programme.title: Submarine Jim (8)
programme.desc: Käpt'n auf Erwachsenenkurs. Serie Frankreich (2024). Die Sardinen sind vom langweiligen Planktonessen frustriert, und Jim will Fabienne, die Chefköchin, zu einer Änderung des Speiseplans bewegen. Da sie nur auf Erwachsene hört, versucht Jim mit Bianca und Siggi, erwachsener zu wirken. Mit großen Hosen, einer Krawatte und neuen Aufgaben entdeckt er die Herausforderungen und den Spaß des Erwachsenwerdens. Am Ende zeigt sich, dass Mut und Freude am Neuen entscheidend sind. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Submarine Jim (9)
programme.desc: Irgendwo im Nirgendwo bohren Jim und Bianca Löcher in den U-Boot-Boden, um Minigolf zu spielen - mit der Folge, dass das ganze Wasser abläuft! Nun sollen sämtliche Flossenflitzer und der Rest der Crew ihre Flossen in die Löcher stecken, um das Schlimmste zu verhindern, doch das klappt natürlich nicht. Käpt'n Jim braucht eine geniale Idee - und wer wäre da besser geeignet als Bianca, die offizielle "Menschen-Expertin" an Bord? Ihr Plan: Sie brauchen dringend Zwiebeln, die die Flossenflitzer zum Weinen bringen sollen, denn Menschen weinen ja immer, wenn sie Zwiebeln schneiden. So startet "Mission Tränenzwiebel". Doch im Zwiebelgarten treffen Jim und Bianca auf ein neugieriges kleines Mädchen. Jim fürchtet sich zunächst, merkt dann aber schnell, dass Menschen gar nicht so furchteinflößend sind, wie Bianca behauptet hat. Und Bianca selbst scheint nicht die allwissende Expertin zu sein, für die sie sich hält. Am Ende spielen die Zwiebeln keine allzu große Rolle mehr - und allen wird klar, dass manchmal Freudentränen die beste Rettungsmission von allen sind.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf II (25)
programme.desc: Die Wanne ist voll. Serie USA (2012). Es ist mal wieder so weit. Zeit für Garys wöchentliches Bad. Doch Gary stellt sich stur. Schafft es SpongeBob, Gary zu überlisten?

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (16)
Das Weihnachtsrennen - Im Hundeschlitten zur großen Liebe
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (34)
programme.desc: Berg-Yoga. Serie Kanada (2019). Beim Morgen-Yoga in den Bergen entdeckt Meckerliese andere Ziegen und klettert zu ihnen, was eine Gerölllawine auslöst und Yumi und Meckerliese von der Gruppe trennt. Frau Gutherz alarmiert die Paw Patrol, die schnell zur Rettung eilt und alle sicher zurückbringt. Das Yoga wird schließlich auf der großen Rasenfläche vor der Zentrale der Paw Patrol fortgesetzt, wobei sogar die Hunde mitmachen. Darsteller: Julian Henneberg, Flemming Stein, Katharin von Keller, Arlette Stanschuss, Ivo Möller, Nils Rieke, Julia Fölster, Kai-Hendrik Möller, Tina Eschmann, Jens Wendland, Sven Dahlem, Uli Pleßmann, Burkhard Schmeer, Jonas Kirsch, Merete Brettschneider, Daniela Reidies, Laura Pfister, Elisa Pioch, Tom Wiedemann, Liza Ohm, Tim Niebuhr, Maria Wardzinska, Elise Eikermann, Joachim Kretzer, Tetje Mierendorf, Martin May, Elena Wilms, Jesse Grimm, Florian Leroy, Selina Böttcher, Ben Küch, Carla Becker, Malin Steffen. Regie Paul Brown

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten XI (35)
programme.desc: Bürgermeisterin Gutherz hat den berühmten Gärtner, Herrn Park in die Abenteuerbucht eingeladen, damit er dort seine Blumenkreationen zeigen kann. In dem Frühlings-Blumengarten befinden sich Herrn Parks Blumenarrangements in Form von Osterhasen, Küken und Ostereiern. Auch eine Form von Chase ist dabei. Bürgermeister Besserwisser beobachtet alles heimlich und ist der Meinung, so etwas könne er auch. Er bastelt aus Blumen selbst einen Osterhasen, der aber eher wie ein Monsterhase aussieht. So beschließt er, die schönen Blumenkreationen in seine Stadt zu bringen. Frau Gutherz ertappt ihn dabei. Als Besserwisser ihr seinen Monsterhasen vors Gesicht hält, erschreckt sich Frau Gutherz so sehr, dass sie auf dem fahrenden Katzenkorb des Bürgermeisters landet. Dabei fällt der Monsterhase auf die Steuerung des Wagens und die beiden Bürgermeister sausen unkontrolliert durch die Stadt. Um ein Haar fahren sie Herrn Park um, in dessen Daumen ein Rosendorn steckt. Schließlich landen sie in der Kanalisation. Herr Park ruft die Paw Patrol um Hilfe. Die müssen nun die beiden BürgermeisterInnen finden und den Dorn aus Herrn Parks Daumen entfernen. Nach einem gelungenen Rettungseinsatz können, Ryder, die Fellfreunde und Frau Gutherz Herrn Park dazu überreden, in der Abenteuerbucht zu bleiben. Und sie haben eine Überraschung für ihn: einen eigenen Blumenladen in der Stadt. Da kann Herr Park natürlich nicht "nein" sagen.

programme.title: Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl II (1)
programme.desc: Ein Geisterjäger ist hinter Pumuckl her! Alfi wohnte als kleiner Junge in Meister Eders Nachbarschaft. Als Kind war er in Franz Eders Werkstatt, wo er sich sicher war: Dort spukt es! Und seitdem glaubt er fest daran, dass in Eders Werkstatt ein Kobold haust. Er will ihn sichtbar machen, um sich und seiner Frau endlich zu beweisen, dass er sich das als kleiner Junge nicht eingebildet hatte. Pumuckl fordert den Geisterjäger heraus. Er ist ein Kobold und ihm haushoch überlegen. Bis dieser eine Fotofalle auspackt. Ist Pumuckl wirklich vor dem Geisterjäger sicher?

programme.title: Unicorn Academy: Wintersonnenwende
programme.desc: Teil 1. Serie (2025). Ein mysteriöses Geheimnis lauert! Als die Wintersonnwendfeier schiefgeht, kommen die Saphire zur Hilfe - und entdecken die wahre Bedeutung des Feiertags. Teil 1 von 2! Darsteller: Bettina Zech, Angelina Markiefka, Carolin Hartmann, Julian Manuel, Melanie Olbert, Maimilian Belle, Matthias Ransberger, Pia Amofa-Antwi, Marcia von Rebay, Christian Jungwirth, Shandra Schadt, Kathrin Gaube, Zina Laus, Bettina Zech

programme.title: Unicorn Academy: Wintersonnenwende
programme.desc: Teil 2. Serie (2025). Ein mysteriöses Geheimnis lauert! Als die Wintersonnwendfeier schiefgeht, kommen die Saphire zur Hilfe - und entdecken die wahre Bedeutung des Feiertags. Teil 2 von 2! Darsteller: Bettina Zech, Angelina Markiefka, Carolin Hartmann, Julian Manuel, Melanie Olbert, Maimilian Belle, Matthias Ransberger, Pia Amofa-Antwi, Marcia von Rebay, Christian Jungwirth, Shandra Schadt, Kathrin Gaube, Zina Laus, Bettina Zech

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf XIV (19)
programme.desc: Schneegelbchen. Serie USA (2024). Als Schneegelbchen zum "Quadratischsten im ganzen Land" gekürt wird, versucht die böse Königin Karen, den Titel mit allen Mitteln für sich zu beanspruchen.
